hypotheses.claim: Approach distance does not alter subsequent open-arena locomotion beyond ordinary stochastic variation.
The short/long difference is explained by different measured arena-entry conditions without a persistent internal state.
requires: raw initial trajectory frames or measured entry heading/speed distributions

hypotheses.claim: Sustained constrained travel creates a decaying directional-persistence state that continuously reduces angular diffusion after arena entry.
hypotheses.reason: The historical 500x60 run failed its frozen promotion rule. Its original held-out losses used the pre-audit scorer and are retained only as history; H3 comparisons re-evaluate the recorded H2 fold candidates under the corrected matched scorer.

hypotheses.claim: Recent sustained constrained walking transiently suppresses the hazard of discrete major reorientation events, while leaving turn angles conditional on an event unchanged.
hypotheses.reason: Failed both frozen guards under the corrected scorer: only 1/6 held-out wins versus H3-null and 2/6 versus matched re-evaluated H2-v1 candidates. Do not tune this same H3 mechanism harder on these outcomes.
hypotheses.distinction_from_H2: H2 continuously scales angular diffusion; H3 changes only event timing in a run-and-reorientation locomotion family.

hypotheses.claim: Recent sustained constrained walking transiently increases moving speed after arena entry while leaving heading noise, pause behavior, entry state, and boundary behavior unchanged.
hypotheses.motivation: The descriptive moving-speed contrast has the H4-predicted sign in every leave-one-colony-out recalculation, while H2 and H3 show that directly increasing directional persistence is not a generalizing explanation. Moving speed remains diagnostic-only and is not an allowed fitting target until the AnimalTA movement classifier is recovered.
hypotheses.distinction_from_H2_H3: H4 changes displacement speed only. It may increase spatial straightness indirectly because angular diffusion is time-based, but it is forbidden from changing angular sigma, turn events, turn angles, or entry heading.

screening_decision.H0_rule: H0 is screening-incompatible when at least two primary structural metric contrasts fall outside descriptive 95% bootstrap intervals and contrast signs are stable under leave-one-colony-out recalculation.
screening_decision.model_competition_rule: New context mechanisms must earn held-out predictive improvement over a nested context-free baseline; fitting the development data better is insufficient.
screening_decision.current_decision: H2-v1 and H3-v1 are both not promoted. H1 remains unresolved because raw entry-state evidence is missing. H4-v1 is now frozen as the next genuinely different mechanism class and must undergo mechanism-reachability implementation before any H4 parameter search.
screening_decision.warning: Open-arena development comparison is internal evidence only. The Y-maze remains the locked cross-apparatus holdout.
